method: Execute unchanged exported producer with synthetic query rows; no production calls.
query:
with requested as (select distinct unnest($1::uuid[]) as id),
     missing as (select id from requested except select id from public.deal),
     comps as (
       select n.id, n.deal_id, d.name as deal_name, n.proposed_on, n.side, n.rate_norm_sf_yr
       from public.v_deal_room_negotiation n
       join public.deal d on d.id = n.deal_id
       where n.deal_id = any($1::uuid[]) and n.rate_norm_sf_yr is not null
       order by n.proposed_on desc, n.id limit 200
     )
     select exists(select 1 from missing) as missing,
       coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(comps)) from comps), '[]'::jsonb) as comps
reuse: Populated and empty recordings reused from checked-out answer-table-empty-match-state; byte-pinned producer verified by executing recordedCompsTable against the captured synthetic query inputs.
contract_cases: CSV assertion runner constructs additional table.v1 cases for null, empty text, Unicode, formulas, boolean and fact/version provenance. These pass through mountAnswerBlocks production parseAnswerBlocks. recordedCompsTable cannot produce boolean or fact-source cells; these are consumer contract cases, not recorded producer output.
